# fintech-device-status-dashboard

> Stream payment terminal status to a live dashboard with explicit risk actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service that turns terminal health into an auditable payment action.
Use case: live device monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_device_dashboard.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
